name: comp-424

frames.best_why: Shows the complete white tag and its X clearly, before the cursor arrives or the tag is dismissed.

tagline: A pale rounded tag with a small X that makes it disappear.
summary: A white pill reading Removable next to a thin grey X; pressing the X removes the tag, leaving the stage empty.
appearance: A white capsule, roughly 300px wide on black, with dark grey sentence-case text and a slim grey X tucked at its right end. Ends are fully rounded and there is no border or shadow.
behaviour: Hovering the X darkens it toward black; clicking it deletes the whole badge at once, and the stage goes blank with no fade or undo.
search_phrases: tag with an x to remove it
delete a label with small cross
get rid of a selected item tag
use_when: Letting people clear applied filters, tags or recipients one at a time.
avoid_when: When removal must be reversible: the tag vanishes instantly with no undo or motion hint.
customise: The label word is hardcoded, so renaming it means editing the file; the pill look comes from the shared badge component and its class list.
weight_why: One small button with a colour transition; no library or animation loop.

a11y.note: The X button carries no accessible name, so screen readers announce an unnamed button; there is no reduced-motion handling.

issues: The close button has no aria-label, so assistive tech meets an unnamed button.
polish_why: Crisp simple capsule with a tidy close affordance; otherwise a familiar default badge.
